name: Reference Ray Registration (R3)
definition: A method to establish semantic consistency between a stylized reference view and novel views by creating a reference dictionary of rays and assigning stylized colors to registered novel view rays.
summary: Reference Ray Registration (R3) propagates style from a 2D reference to 3D novel views by mapping pixels to a 3D voxel dictionary using pseudo-depth, unlike methods relying on 2D warping.
